explication: Bear Blog is a hosted blogging service: writers create and configure blogs, publish posts, and manage their audience; readers visit hosted blogs, subscribe, discover posts, and vote. The repository’s main runtime is a Django application with URL dispatch, domain-specific views, shared rendering/helpers, and model-backed state. The README describes the product at a high level; detailed capabilities and connections below are limited to the provided source excerpts and SOURCE INDEX, so unsampled subsystem links are omitted where they cannot be verified.
